_notes: Character voices (L34). Each key is a voice name used as "voice":"<name>" on a line in tools/voice-lines.json and as say(text,{voice:'<name>'}) in code. voice = ElevenLabs voice id (from the voice library or Voice Design); model / settings / prefix default to the announcer's in voice-lines.json. A cast member with an empty voice id is skipped by make-voices.mjs until it's cast (the game uses its robot voice meanwhile). robot = optional {pitch, rate} for that robot voice (default: a pitch picked from the name). desc = the personality notes the audio agent casts from. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

hank.desc: Hank: gravelly, friendly old-timer next to the start. Placeholder entry until AU13 casts him.

garry.desc: Garry the Gnome: a tiny garden gnome on a lawnmower. Whispery, very polite, says please and oh my. Uncast until AU13.

zippy.desc: Zippy the Mail Truck: talks super fast, runs words together, always in a hurry. Uncast until AU13.

fern.desc: Farmer Fern: a red tractor in a straw hat. Loud, happy country farmer who laughs at everything (Ha-HA!). Uncast until AU13.

bubbles.desc: Bubbles the Fire Truck: an eager, squeaky rookie whose voice cracks when excited. Uncast until AU13.

pip.desc: Pip the Ice-Cream Truck: sing-songy and sweet, half-sings lines like an ice-cream jingle. Uncast until AU13.

zorp.desc: Zorp (with Blip): a tiny high, squeaky alien whose saucer crashed in the cornfield; beeps and boops. Blip is its own voice (`blip`, per-line voices L40). Uncast until AU13.

blip.desc: Blip (with Zorp): a round purple alien with three little eyes. Low, bubbly, slow; finishes Zorp's sentences ("...boop!"). Uncast until AU13.

dot.desc: Dozer Dot: a tough little orange bulldozer. Excited, shouty kid energy, LETS SMASH! Uncast until AU13.

wheelie.desc: Mayor Wheelie: a purple limo in a top hat. Booming, pompous, very proud of himself, rolls his Rs. Uncast until AU13.

kite.desc: Captain Kite: a hovercraft. Laid-back surfer dude, slow and sunny, says duuude. Uncast until AU13.

woolly.desc: Woolly the Sheepdog Van: worried and huffy, out of breath, a little bark in it. Uncast until AU13.
